entries.title: Job 40:1
segments: ¶Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said:

entries.title: Job 40:2
segments: "Shall the one who contends with the Almighty correct [Him]? He who rebukes God, let him answer it."

entries.title: Job 40:3
segments: Then Job answered the LORD and said:

entries.title: Job 40:4
segments: "Behold, I am vile; What shall I answer You? I lay my hand over my mouth.

entries.title: Job 40:5
segments: Once I have spoken, but I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further."

entries.title: Job 40:6
segments: ¶Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

entries.title: Job 40:7
segments: "Now prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me:

entries.title: Job 40:8
segments: "Would you indeed annul My judgment? Would you condemn Me that you may be justified?

entries.title: Job 40:9
segments: Have you an arm like God? Or can you thunder with a voice like His?

entries.title: Job 40:10
segments: Then adorn yourself [with] majesty and splendor, and array yourself with glory and beauty.

entries.title: Job 40:11
segments: Disperse the rage of your wrath; Look on everyone [who is] proud, and humble him.

entries.title: Job 40:12
segments: Look on everyone [who is] proud, [and] bring him low; Tread down the wicked in their place.

entries.title: Job 40:13
segments: Hide them in the dust together, Bind their faces in hidden [darkness].

entries.title: Job 40:14
segments: Then I will also confess to you That your own right hand can save you.

entries.title: Job 40:15
segments: ¶"Look now at the behemoth, which I made [along] with you; He eats grass like an ox.

entries.title: Job 40:16
segments: See now, his strength [is] in his hips, And his power [is] in his stomach muscles.

entries.title: Job 40:17
segments: He moves his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.

entries.title: Job 40:18
segments: His bones [are like] beams of bronze, His ribs like bars of iron.

entries.title: Job 40:19
segments: He [is] the first of the ways of God; Only He who made him can bring near His sword.

entries.title: Job 40:20
segments: Surely the mountains yield food for him, And all the beasts of the field play there.

entries.title: Job 40:21
segments: He lies under the lotus trees, In a covert of reeds and marsh.

entries.title: Job 40:22
segments: The lotus trees cover him [with] their shade; The willows by the brook surround him.

entries.title: Job 40:23
segments: Indeed the river may rage, [Yet] he is not disturbed; He is confident, though the Jordan gushes into his mouth,

entries.title: Job 40:24
segments: [Though] he takes it in his eyes, [Or] one pierces [his] nose with a snare.
